summary: "Mother-in-Law" is a 1961 song recorded by Ernie K-Doe. The note states it reached number one in the U.S. on both the Billboard Hot 100 and the Billboard R&B chart. It was written and produced by Allen Toussaint, who also played the piano solo, and was issued by Minit Records.
one_line: Ernie K-Doe's 1961 song "Mother-in-Law", a U.S. number-one hit written and produced by Allen Toussaint.
key_facts: "Mother-in-Law" is a 1961 song recorded by Ernie K-Doe.
"Mother-in-Law" was a number-one hit in the U.S. on the Billboard Hot 100 chart.
"Mother-in-Law" was a number-one hit in the U.S. on the Billboard R&B chart.
Allen Toussaint played the piano solo on "Mother-in-Law".
